title: CourseAsCode Course Configuration
description: Schema for config.yaml — the root course configuration file

CourseName.description: Full course name displayed in Moodle

ShortName.description: Short course name — must be unique across the Moodle instance

Summary.description: Course summary shown on the course listing page

Visible.description: Whether the course is visible to students

StartDate.description: Course start date. Format: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM

EndDate.description: Course end date. Format: DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM

IdNumber.description: Internal Moodle ID number for the course

ShowGrades.description: Whether the gradebook is visible to students

ForceGroupMode.description: Force the group mode on all activities

NumberOfAnnouncements.description: Number of recent announcements shown on the course page

ForcedLanguage.description: Force the interface language for this course, e.g. 'en'

GradeCategoriesPath.description: Relative path to the grade categories YAML file

GradingInfosPath.description: Relative path to the grading info YAML file

ShowActivityDates.description: Show activity open/close dates on the course page

ShowCompletionConditions.description: Show completion conditions on activity cards

QuestionListPaths.description: List of relative paths to question bank YAML files
